**Connection limitation**
- Your suspicion was right. The Google token is marked `invalid_reconnect_required`, so there is no verified API connection right now.
- The numbers above come from the local database, which holds whatever was imported before the token expired. I can't sync new or edited data until you reconnect. Any changes Google made to these days after the last sync won't appear here.
- The ghealth CLI credentials weren't found. If your Google consent screen is in Testing mode, refresh tokens expire after 7 days. To fix that, run `ghealth auth login`, and the server will pick up the new credentials. I can also start a reconnect from here if you'd like.
- Another option is to import a Google Takeout export. That works without API access.
